newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria in market for 26,000 tonnes white/raw sugar.
newsitem.headline: Syria in market for 26,000 tonnes white/raw sugar.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs (GEZA) has issued a tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws, GEZA said in a statement on Monday.
It said that November 5 was set as the final date to receive bids and that the sugar should be shipped between 25 November and 25 December.
Results of the tender would be made available on November 6, the statement said.
